all-tables-random-lgs-pods: 38.3% of games and 33.3% of series won across 1,800 random tables, 2 points behind the bracket 4 list. The 4 swaps cost the combo kill and some speed.
Same weak spots: Tokens / go-wide (32.7%), Landfall (34.3%) and Aggro (35.2%). Fynn's poison and Jetmir's go-wide knock you out most.
The planeswalkers carry it: Ajani Unrelenting and Elspeth, Sun's Champion win 61% of the games they're cast in.
When Lae'zel never resolves you win 12% of games, so protect her: Swiftfoot Boots and Lightning Greaves on her are worth the mana.
